rows.name: Overall (BenchAlign score)

rows.metrics: quality, cost, time, speed, uncertainty, effort, date, breakdown, other
rows.metrics_detail:

Cost [page]: input and output price — API price USD per 1M tokens · https://benchlm.ai/
Time [page]: Latency — seconds to first answer token (Artificial Analysis) · https://benchlm.ai/
Speed [page]: output tokens per second — median tok/s (Artificial Analysis) · https://benchlm.ai/
Uncertainty [page]: 90% interval — posterior interval on the overall score · https://benchlm.ai/data/leaderboard.json

rows.name: Humanity's Last Exam (full, 2,500 questions)
rows.focus: Multi-modal, expert-written closed-ended academic questions (multiple-choice and exact-match) across dozens of subjects; ~14% need an image.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: score (e.g. '54.80') — Accuracy (%) on the full 2,500-question HLE, o3-mini judge · https://labs.scale.com/leaderboard/humanitys_last_exam
Uncertainty [page]: ± (e.g. '54.80±1.94') — 95% confidence interval half-width (data field confidenceInterval_upper) · https://labs.scale.com/leaderboard/humanitys_last_exam
Effort [page]: model-name suffix, e.g. '(xhigh)', '(thinking high)' — Separate entries per reasoning effort, encoded only in the model name · https://labs.scale.com/leader
rows.notes: Leaderboard is Scale AI SEAL (HLE co-creator; linked from lastexam.ai as 'Also available at ... SEAL LLM Leaderboards'). lastexam.ai's own table (judge o3-mini, dataset 2025-04-03) is older: 1. Gemini 3 Pro (38.3) 2. GPT-5 (25.3) 3. Grok 4 (24.5). Scale ranks by Rank (Upper Bound); order above is by listed score.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L4 (Expert); bootstrap agreement: L4 100%.
Placed from 16 models' published scores; guessing floor 5% removed.
Best observed: GPT-6 Astra 54.8, Claude Sonnet 5.5 (xhigh) 46.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash 44.5.
Official difficulty: Paper/lastexam.ai: designed to be at the frontier of human knowledge; questions filtered so frontier LLMs failed them.

Note: Could not verify any results. (JS-rendered, not readable). The Scale HLE page mentions HLE-Rolling (2026-09-17 update) only as a migration path, and its board still shows the 2,
rows.notes: Released 2025-10-08; change log at github hle-rolling-changes.txt (latest entries 07/27/2026). No separate official leaderboard found. Gated dataset.
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: No per-model scores published anywhere official: lastexam.ai only links the dataset and change log; the Scale SEAL HLE pages only announce HLE-Rolling (Update September 17, 2026) and still score the original 2,500-question set; the CAIS data embedded in lastexam.ai has only 'hle' (original) and 'hle_diamond' fields. Also a moving target (continually updated).

rows.name: HLE-Diamond
rows.focus: Refined 1,000-question subset of HLE (500 reasoning + 500 knowledge) after a year of cleaning, evaluated without tools.
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: Accuracy (%) — HLE-Diamond accuracy, 1,000 questions, no tools, 'reasoning high' (128k output cap); bar chart of 10 models · https://lastexam.ai/blog/hle-diamond
Tokens [page]: Token Usage — Mean output tokens per model at reasoning high (e.g. 3.3k to 59.2k, log axis) · https://lastexam.ai/blog/hle-diamond
Breakdown [page]: Reasoning / Knowledge — Separate accuracy for the two 500-question partitions · https://lastexam.ai/blog/hle-diamond
Not reported: cost, time, speed, uncertai
rows.notes: Released 2026-09-22. Results chart on the release post (reasoning high, 128k output cap); a 'reasoning max' view also exists on the page. Dataset gated: cais/hle-diamond.
rows.difficulty_detail:
Fitted level L4 (Expert); bootstrap agreement: L4 100%.
Placed from 18 models' published scores.
Best observed: Claude Fable 5.2 (high) 74.3, GPT-6.2 Astra (high) 66.6, Gemini 4 Neon (high) 65.2.
Official difficulty: Release post: refined 1,000-question subset after a year of cleaning, for when frontier models hit the noise ceiling of original HLE.

Quality [paper]: Other — Accuracy (%) column (unlabelled; matches overall accuracy) in Table 3 'Category-wise breakdown of model performance on HLE', separate Text-Only and Full Dataset blocks · https://arxiv.org/html/2501.14249#A3.SS3
Not reported: cost, time, speed, tokens, uncertainty, runs, effort, date, breakdown, votes, other
Note: Same Table 3 column layout as 4.8. The category score exists only as a paper table column for the paper's early models. Calibration error and token counts are p
rows.notes: Per-category results only in the HLE paper (arXiv 2501.14249v12, Appendix C.3 Table 3, 'Full Dataset' block; early-2025 models only). No official per-category leaderboard. Ties shown as on the page. URL anchor is the paper's C.3 'Categorical Results' section (anchor id A3.SS3 confirmed in page HTML).
